title: StableIdentityV1
description: Canonical stable-identity envelope (document 16 section 3.2, shared foundation section 4.1). This file is also the single source of truth for the shared canonical primitives under $defs; every other canonical schema composes them by $ref and never restates a rule.

uuid.$comment: Opaque lower-case canonical UUID string on exchange.

timestamp.$comment: RFC 3339 UTC instant. The canonical hash profile requires the trailing Z form.

decimal_string.$comment: Exact decimal carried as a string; never an unstable binary float.

canonical_type_token.$comment: Snake-case canonical type discriminator. The negative pattern is the pre-ADR regulatory guard: no generic type token may activate a regulatory canonical type before ADR-DATACOMPANY-REGULATORY-MODEL is accepted. The guard is written as family stems, never as the pinned token spellings: config/pre-adr-regulatory-denylist.json is the single source of truth for those, and a released schema that respelled them would itself be a repository-wide denylist activation. Stems are strictly broader than the pinned tokens, so this rejects every one of them and their unlisted relatives.

bounded_context.$comment: Registered owning bounded context. Carries the same pre-ADR negative guard, in the same stem form and for the same reason.

actor_subject.$comment: Verified actor or service subject from context, never a mutable domain payload field.

schema_ref.$comment: Stable schema ID plus schema version.

payload_digest.$comment: Exact-byte digest. Never substituted for content_hash and never a public identity.

version_number.$comment: Bounded by the largest integer an IEEE-754 double represents exactly. RFC 8785 serializes numbers with the ECMAScript Number::toString algorithm, so a larger value has no stable canonical form and could never be hashed; the boundary must not accept an object the canonical hash algorithm cannot process.

resource_scope_conditional.$comment: resource_tenant_id is required iff resource_scope is tenant and forbidden iff it is global. Identical at every nesting depth; no nullable tenant ID may replace it.

aggregate_version.$comment: Optimistic-concurrency and event-order counter. Mutable, not content: excluded from every canonical hash view. Bounded by the exact IEEE-754 double range for the same reason version_number is, so the boundary never accepts a counter the canonical algorithm could not serialize if it were ever included.

domain_extension.$comment: Declared composition point. A domain schema adds its own fields here and seals the fully composed boundary with unevaluatedProperties:false.

context_owned_extension.$comment: workspace_id and project_id exist only for a declared context-owned type. A type that does not compose this extension leaves them unevaluated, so the sealed domain boundary rejects them.

sealed.$comment: Fully composed boundary for a StableIdentity used without domain extension.
